doc: G71 (Fable guidance v12): every lattice concept name the lattice emits gets one parent class from a fixed 5-class mapping, and each class sits under its image-schema top(s). Authored once by meaning (not per pair). Read by tools/owl/t58_export.py (axioms SubClassOf(lat:<name> t58:<Class>) and SubClassOf(t58:<Class> t58:<TOP>), classes declared in the t58 namespace so no recogniser name is added) and by tools/dream/routeA_dl.py (--pick t71: sibling rule over these classes).
emitted_vocabulary: every name occupancy2.prepare emits on any input grid of the 898 design training tasks under its 5 abstractions, probe v29 / V34 vocabulary (identical attributes / extra_attrs / prepare code): 117 names; counts = grid x abstraction occurrences (results/o0/t71_phi_design.json)

ShapeProperty.comment: shape properties of an object's cell set

PositionProperty.comment: position in the grid, extremes, alignment

ColourRole.comment: own colour and colour frequency roles

Relation.comment: contact / containment / existential relation to another object

families.why: shape of the object's own cell set (G71 list)
multiplicity of the object's normalised shape among the objects: a property computed from its shape
fill density of the bbox: shape (not emitted under V29/V34)
position in the grid / extreme position (G71: touches_border, extreme_*)
bbox row or column overlap with an object of colour c (G71: aligned_*)
half-plane position (G71: half_plane_*; not emitted under V29/V34)
row / column alignment with colour c (aligned_* per axis; not emitted under V29/V34)
own colour and its frequency rank among objects (G71 colour properties)
number of objects of the same colour (not emitted under V29/V34)
size and size rank (G71 size/rank; single_pixel == size=1)
size rank, descending / ascending (G71 size_rank_*)
size extreme within its colour class
hole count (G71 lists n_holes under size/rank)
bbox dimensions (not emitted under V29/V34)
contact / containment with another object (G71 relational; isolated = no contact)
colour of a touching object (already <= touches_other in the T-box)
colour of the smallest container (already <= inside_other in the T-box)
number of 4-touching objects (contact count)
another (non-border, other-coloured) object with the same hole count / size: existential relation to another object
an object of colour c has the same shape (not emitted under V29/V34)
contains an object of colour c (not emitted under V29/V34)
position relative to the largest object (G71: *_of_largest; not emitted under V29/V34)

not_placed.why: pixel-level names of the P_pixel refinement stratum: their individuals are the cells of one object, not lattice objects (obj:<name> repeats the object's own names)
S_atoms fallback stratum (solve() only, never solve_once): 420 grid-level Codex detector evidence sets used as cell markers; no per-name meaning in the lattice
S_codex selector outputs; not in the V29 / V34 vocabulary
no other cell of its colour inside its bbox: mixes colour and containment, neither class fits; not emitted under V29 / V34
